# flutter-mcp-toolkit
# https://llmstxt.org — for agents USING the toolkit

> Dart MCP server + Flutter `mcp_toolkit` package. Inspect and drive a **running debug Flutter app** (semantic UI, input, hot reload, app-defined tools). Not a substitute for the official Dart MCP server (static analysis / tooling).

## Docs

- Site: https://docs.page/arenukvern/mcp_flutter
- Quickstart: docs/quickstart.mdx
- Tool reference (generated): docs/reference/tools.mdx
- Human index: docs/index.mdx

## When to use

| Use this | Not this |
| --- | --- |
| Live UI, taps, screenshots, app custom tools | `dart_mcp_server` for analyzer/tests only |
| Debug `flutter run` with `mcp_toolkit` in main() | Release/profile builds without VM service |
| Claude/Cursor/Codex MCP + skills | Guessing UI from source |

## Install (server binary required)

Every path still needs **`flutter-mcp-toolkit-server` on PATH** (marketplace/plugins ship skills and MCP config, not the server binary).

1. **Script (recommended first)** — `curl -fsSL …/install.sh | bash` → `flutter-mcp-toolkit-server` on PATH.
2. **Marketplace / plugin** — Claude: `/plugin marketplace add Arenukvern/mcp_flutter` then `/plugin install flutter-mcp-toolkit@flutter-mcp-toolkit`; Cursor: install script first, then `flutter-mcp-toolkit init cursor`.
3. **Docker / from source** — secondary; see docs/install/docker.mdx and docs/install/platforms.mdx.

`init claude-code` / `cline` / `agents-skills`: **skills only** — add MCP server manually.

## App requirement

```bash
flutter-mcp-toolkit codegen-init   # pub add + main() snippet — paste before runApp
flutter run --debug
```

## MCP server

```json
{ "command": "flutter-mcp-toolkit-server", "args": [] }
```

Optional: `--dumps` for heavy tree dumps (off by default).

## Verify

```bash
flutter-mcp-toolkit doctor
```

Then: `fmt_discover_debug_apps` → `fmt_semantic_snapshot` (or `fmt_get_screenshots`).

## Core loop tools

discover → connect → semantic_snapshot → tap_widget / enter_text → hot_reload_flutter → wait_for stable.

Full names: docs/reference/tools.mdx.

## Platforms

Release binaries: macOS **arm64**, Linux **x64**. Intel Mac: deprecated (build from source). Windows: no install.sh; use WSL/Linux binary or build from source. App targets: any Flutter platform in debug when instrumented.
